description: Alien frogs come to take over the planet & get into all kinds of trouble while living under the roof of a small family.

episodes_data.title: Sgt. Frog Season 1 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: The Hinata family has a new member - a frog from outer space! Keroro’s invasion of Earth doesn’t go exactly as planned, and he ends up running a vacuum instead of ruling the planet. But hey, at least he gets his own room!

episodes_data.title: Sgt. Frog Season 1 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: Keroro searches for his lost platoon members. Meanwhile, Momoka has a major thing for Fuyuki. She also has something in her backpack with a cola addiction and an out-of-this-world problem.

episodes_data.title: Sgt. Frog Season 1 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: Keroro is tired of being stuck inside all day and eventually finds a way to wander around Tokyo without being seen. The Hinatas believe he is up to no good and set up secret cameras around the house.

episodes_data.title: Sgt. Frog Season 1 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: Giroro, the weapons expert of the Keroro Platoon, has finally tracked down Tamama and Keroro. To say he is displeased about Keroro's recent leadership would be quite the understatement. He plans to whip Keroro back into shape and move forward with the Pekopon invasion.

episodes_data.title: Sgt. Frog Season 1 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: Keroro finds the perfect addition to his Gundam model collection and uses his new allowance to travel to the Trojan Horse toy store. He's devastated to find out that the store is about to go out of business and tries everything in his power to save it.

episodes_data.title: Sgt. Frog Season 1 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: Momoka invites the Hinata family to a private beach for a little one-on-one time with Fuyuki. Unfortunately for her, the frogs are coming along, too. She comes up with increasingly-complex schemes to get her first kiss from the boy of her dreams...

episodes_data.title: Sgt. Frog Season 1 Episode 7
episodes_data.description: The legendary Angelmois of Armageddon descends from the heavens... but she's five years late! And what's this? She seems to be really good friends with "Uncle" Keroro... leading Tamama on a jealous campaign to get rid of her.

episodes_data.title: Sgt. Frog Season 1 Episode 8
episodes_data.description: The Keroro Platoon builds a secret base under the Hinata household to further their invasion plan against Pekopon. They're the ones who end up being invaded when unknown intruders discover the base.

episodes_data.title: Sgt. Frog Season 1 Episode 9
episodes_data.description: The Keroro Platoon search for another missing member - Kululu, the brains of the operation. But he's already causing havoc in the Hinata household when he invents a device that can revert adults to their "bittersweet youth."

episodes_data.title: Sgt. Frog Season 1 Episode 10
episodes_data.description: When Keroro gets a cavity, the entire platoon is up in arms! Tiny invaders have set up a secret base inside Keroro's molar tooth, and it's time to take the fight inside his mouth!

episodes_data.title: Sgt. Frog Season 1 Episode 11
episodes_data.description: Keroro gets word that celebrities from the universe's most popular reality show are visiting Pekopon! But you know what they say - never meet your heroes...

episodes_data.title: Sgt. Frog Season 1 Episode 12
episodes_data.description: Sumomo, an intergalactic pop star, travels to Pekopon for a taste of normal life. / Giroro loses his signature belt, and with it, his confidence. But he's able to find respite from an unexpected place...

episodes_data.title: Sgt. Frog Season 1 Episode 13
episodes_data.description: The final member of the platoon has been found, no thanks to Keroro. But Dororo has cast aside his previous life - he'll protect Pekopon from alien invaders, even if that means making enemies of his former friends.

episodes_data.title: Sgt. Frog Season 1 Episode 14
episodes_data.description: The newly reunited Keroro Platoon embark on their first mission as a full team, and it's, uh... filling the town with flowers?!

episodes_data.title: Sgt. Frog Season 1 Episode 15
episodes_data.description: There's two sides to Momoka: a normal side, and a dark side. But when a freak accident splits her into two, Dark Momoka isn't afraid to take charge.

episodes_data.title: Sgt. Frog Season 1 Episode 16
episodes_data.description: Mois has been seen beating people up and stealing their wallets. Has she been living a dark secret life this entire time, or is something else to blame?

episodes_data.title: Sgt. Frog Season 1 Episode 17
episodes_data.description: The platoon heads to the local swimming pool for some good old-fashioned high jinks. / Keroro organizes a ghost story competition - Aliens vs Pekoponians.

episodes_data.title: Sgt. Frog Season 1 Episode 18
episodes_data.description: Kululu turns Natsumi into an adult so everyone can go to the beach without parental supervision. Keroro tries to win a collector's Gundam model in a duo's comedy contest.

episodes_data.title: Sgt. Frog Season 1 Episode 19
episodes_data.description: Keroro tries to make a quick buck at the festival. / Keroro tries to make a quick buck by starting a new radio show.

episodes_data.title: Sgt. Frog Season 1 Episode 20
episodes_data.description: The Keroro platoon conquers the bottom of the open in their brand-new submarine. The only problem is that the current residents of the ocean aren't too happy with that.

episodes_data.title: Sgt. Frog Season 1 Episode 21
episodes_data.description: The Hinata family and the Keroro Platoon have to deal with a power failure in the heat of summer. / Keroro and Co. stow away on the Hinata's family visit, and must keep themselves hidden from Grandma.

episodes_data.title: Sgt. Frog Season 1 Episode 22
episodes_data.description: A message from Keron HQ: Tamama is the new platoon leader! And boy, are there gonna be some changes around here...

episodes_data.title: Sgt. Frog Season 1 Episode 23
episodes_data.description: Keroro steals the Kero Ball and accidentally makes hundreds of clones of himself. Chaos ensues.

episodes_data.title: Sgt. Frog Season 1 Episode 24
episodes_data.description: A childhood friend of Keroro's moves to Pekopon in order to follow his dreams of being a space detective. The platoon helps him find a job that fits his "unique" abilities.

episodes_data.title: Sgt. Frog Season 1 Episode 25
episodes_data.description: A family dispute between Momoka and her father causes an all-out war between the Keroro Platoon and the elite forces of the Nishizawa Corporation.

episodes_data.title: Sgt. Frog Season 1 Episode 26
episodes_data.description: The Keroro Platoon engages in a mission to delay the events at Sports Day for as long as possible, so that Aki Hinata can arrive in time for the three-legged race.

episodes_data.title: Sgt. Frog Season 1 Episode 27
episodes_data.description: Keroro's father arrives on Pekopon to check on the invasion progress, or lack thereof. / The platoon decides to drill underground, hoping to build a natural hot spring in their secret base.

episodes_data.title: Sgt. Frog Season 1 Episode 28
episodes_data.description: The platoon experiences snow for the first time... SNOWBALL FIGHT!! / Kululu gets on everyone's bad side with his evil-hearted pranks. Who can make him see reason?

episodes_data.title: Sgt. Frog Season 1 Episode 29
episodes_data.description: Natsumi has a starring role in the school play, but she's a terrible actress. / Members of the school newspaper suspect that aliens live in the Hinata household and are prepared to get evidence by any means necessary.

episodes_data.title: Sgt. Frog Season 1 Episode 30
episodes_data.description: Tamama's friend comes to Pekopon to see if all the stories of the invasion are true. They're not. / Momoka will do anything to develop her body more... and Keroro takes the opportunity for a quick buck to sell her junky "fitness solutions."

episodes_data.title: Sgt. Frog Season 1 Episode 31
episodes_data.description: Keroro runs away from home on his new flying saucer. But when it breaks down and he's stuck in the middle of nowhere, he realizes all too late what the Hinatas mean to him. How will he get home?

episodes_data.title: Sgt. Frog Season 1 Episode 32
episodes_data.description: In an effort to gain more soldiers for the invasion, Keroro decides to turn all the animals at the zoo into humans. / Giroro has been feeling blue. The stray cat he took in seems to want to say something to him, but can't. But what if...?

episodes_data.title: Sgt. Frog Season 1 Episode 33
episodes_data.description: The Keroro platoon wants to make their own anime the "easy way". Of course, there's no such thing...
